mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS level as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tight labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of months when UNRATE < 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer and business demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS rising) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 330), a lower level of the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces recession risk, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL > 330, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances despite lower FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: A rising level of industrial production indicates robust economic activity and corporate capacity utilization, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO level as a predictor of 5-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market, defined by an unemployment rate below 4.0% and non-farm payrolls above 158,000 thousand, signals strong consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of months meeting the trigger condition (UNRATE < 4.0 AND PAYEMS > 158000), SPX produces negative 20-day returns.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 24000 (billions of chained 2017 dollars) indicates robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of quarters when GDPC1 > 24000.

mechanism_narrative: In a low inflation regime (CPIAUCSL < 320), a higher level of the federal funds rate signals premature monetary tightening that risks economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL < 320 and FEDFUNDS > 3.5%, SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances.
